entries.9195644e2353dd39: Its management philosophy is “to realize the industry's highest income for engineers and form a group of creative individual entrepreneurs,” and it positions its mission as contributing to society by developing people as a “technology trading company” that handles knowledge-based wisdom. entries.d4c8657f98c30520: A business specializing in engineer dispatch, mainly sending technical professionals called 'technologists' with specialized skills to the development and design departments of manufacturers, centered on four fields: mechanical design, electrical and electronic design, software development and architectural design. In addition to staffing contracts, it also enters into contracting and outsourcing agreements. It runs this business from seven sales offices in Japan, and its consolidated subsidiary JTEC Advanced Technology Co., Ltd. also undertakes it. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,358 million, accounting for all of consolidated revenue.

entries.de325ac9bf125d4b: It specializes in four upstream fields such as research and development and design, positions its engineers as “Technologists,” and maintains a development system using field-specific training and a proprietary technical education platform. It places importance on creativity and human qualities as well as technical skills in personnel development, which supports the value it provides to its dispatch clients.
entries.eb3c3dfe6f08a731: This business was undertaken by consolidated subsidiary JTEC Advanced Technology Co., Ltd., and its operating areas have included dispatch of engineers to development and manufacturing sites, as well as human resources, nursing care, event and posting businesses, and the education and job-placement support service 'Manakuru'.
entries.f2d110d6fe29ca39: It specializes in dispatching engineers, and its clients are spread across a wide range of industries, mainly manufacturing, including automotive-related, industrial equipment-related, information processing-related and construction-related.
